contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: A party dress on SHEIN Brazil comes down to three things: the occasion, the fabric and the arrival date. For Christmas and New Year's Eve, delivery time matters more than the cut. For a graduation or a wedding guest look, the choice is about colour, length and the tone of the event. This guide explains each point with the store's own product details.

contentSections.heading: Choosing by occasion
paragraphs: Year-end parties: the deadline comes first. The delivery estimate appears only on the order page, so confirm it before you pay if the party is a few weeks away.
Graduation: colour and length decide. Check the invitation and the time of the ceremony. An evening event suits a long or midi dress; in daytime, a shorter length works better.
Wedding guest: the tone of the event comes before the model. Day or evening, church or venue. Check the invitation before you choose the colour.
Wedding dresses and bridesmaid dresses are not covered here.

contentSections.heading: Reading the product description
paragraphs: The product description tells you more than the photo. Look at:
bullets: **Fabric:** polyester with elastane is common in these dresses. Check the percentages, not just the name.
**Lining and sheerness:** without lining, the colour of your underwear can show.
**Length:** midi, long and short change the look. Titles and descriptions do not always agree, so check the measurement in centimetres.
**Care:** the description says whether the dress is machine washed, hand washed or dry cleaned only.

contentSections.heading: Size: use the measurements of the garment
paragraphs: SHEIN publishes a size guide for each product, in centimetres and inches, with instructions on how to measure. There is no single size chart, so use the guide of the dress you chose. Plus sizes follow the same method: compare the garment's measurements with yours, not the number on the label.

contentSections.heading: Delivery time: add it to the party date
paragraphs: Orders take 3 to 5 days to be processed before they ship. Add that time to the delivery estimate on the order page. If the total goes past the party date, this dress is not the right purchase for that date.

contentSections.heading: Taxes: check the order summary
paragraphs: Import taxes depend on the country where the order arrives and on the order value. The order summary shows the amount before you pay.

contentSections.heading: Returns and exchanges
paragraphs: The store page has the return rules for each seller. To change the size, return the item and place a new order.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay
paragraphs: Check the delivery estimate and the order summary before you pay, and keep the order confirmation. The 4CW5Y code is SHEIN Brazil's referral code, not a coupon: you search it in the app, and it gives no discount. How it works is explained in [the referral guide](/en/reviews/shein-referral-code-where-to-enter), and current campaigns are on the [SHEIN store page](/en/coupons/shein).

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Can a SHEIN party dress arrive in time for Christmas? It depends on the order date and the delivery estimate on the order page. Compare that date with the date of the party.
How do I know if a dress is long or midi? By the length in the product description and the centimetre measurements in the size guide.
Does the 4CW5Y code give a discount? No. It is a referral code, not a coupon, and it gives no discount.
